A panel that loads sooner, and says so while it does.

**Faster.**
- The docs folder is read in parallel instead of one entry after another, and so are the checks that match tags and read marks to the files.
- When the panel opens, the tree comes first, then tags, colours and read marks as saved, then the open file. Matching the marks to moved files and scanning Claude Code sessions for mentions come after, instead of holding up the page.
- Pages opened lately are kept rendered, and open again at once while the file has not changed.
- A page no longer waits for the files it names to be looked up. It is shown with the links found last time and corrected when they have been worked out again. Names that are not docs are looked up a few at a time, and what was found is shared by every page for ten minutes, so a file change no longer makes every page look them all up again.

**Clearer.**
- The tree says "Loading the docs…" until the files arrive, and the page says "Loading <file>…" when a file takes more than a moment, instead of an empty panel or a tree with only the trash in it.

Install: download `docs-panel-0.10.2.vsix` below, then run `code --install-extension docs-panel-0.10.2.vsix`.
